samples.summary: Design doc carries PR rationale rather than behavior. The `setRangeBorders` section closes with "This is why the preset path does not use `setStyle`, whose contract is to preserve an explicit `false`" (line 91-92), which duplicates the reasoning already recorded in docs/tasks/active/20260822-sheets-clear-borders-prune-lessons.md and the code comment on `Sheet.applyBorderPatch` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:3985). Design docs in this repo describe the resulting semantics; the "why not the other implementation" note belongs in the lessons/todo file. Taste-level only — the described behavior itself matches the implementation (prune via `pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys` + `getStyleSources`, keep `false` when a layer conflicts, leave untouched when everything prunes).

The new `setRangeBorders(preset)` section documents the pruning semantics but not the selection-size cap (`MaxBorderSelectionCells`, sheet.ts:3953) that makes the call a silent no-op for large selections — even though docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md:266 already cites "the `setRangeBorders` cap precedent" as if it were documented here. Since this delta is the first place the method gets its own section, folding one line about the cap in would make that cross-reference resolve. Pre-existing gap, non-blocking.
